name: Foliocast – Portfolio Post Scheduler
author: Foliocast

sections.description:
Early access: while Meta reviews the Foliocast app, connecting Instagram needs a tester invitation. Click “Connect with Instagram” and fill in the “Request my invitation” form: we invite your account and email you the steps.

Your work, posted. Foliocast turns each project of your WordPress portfolio into an Instagram post, and publishes it at the planned time. For artists, designers, photographers, architects and studios.

  1. It reads your portfolio: the projects already on your site and their images, whatever your theme.
  2. It prepares the posts: visuals cropped for Instagram, a caption and hashtags in 7 languages, the credits of the project. Everything stays editable.
  3. You approve, it publishes: on time, through the official Instagram API, straight from your site. Your computer can stay off.

Also included: carousels and your own videos as Reels, a month planner (drag a post to another day), a preview of your grid, statistics per post, light and dark themes, and an installable app for phone and computer. Nothing in this plugin is locked or time-limited.

Optional paid plans (Reels made from your images, other networks, and more) come as a separate plugin that installs next to this one: foliocast.fr.

Foliocast is an independent service, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta. Instagram is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.

Requirements

  • A professional Instagram account (Creator or Business, free to switch in the Instagram app).
  • A WordPress site reachable on the internet (Instagram downloads the images from it).
  • For posts exactly on time: on-time publishing by Foliocast (one click, free) or a cron job at your host. Otherwise WordPress’s scheduler runs when someone visits your site.

External services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services. Nothing is sent before you connect an account or enable the feature.

Instagram API (Meta)

Used to publish your posts and read your account details and post statistics. Requests go from your site to graph.instagram.com (or to graph.facebook.com if you pasted an access token made with Facebook login, for an Instagram account linked to a Facebook Page).

  • When: when you connect your Instagram account, when a post is published, when the app shows your live Instagram grid or checks whether a published post still exists, when the access token is renewed (about every 50 days) and when the statistics of a post are refreshed (during its first 30 days: every 3 hours at first, then every 12 hours, then every 2 days).
  • What is sent: your Instagram access token and account ID, the public addresses of the images or videos to publish, the caption and the alternative text of each image.
  • Instagram Terms of Use: https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870
  • Meta Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

Foliocast Connect (foliocast.fr)

Used only for the “Connect with Instagram” button: it lets you log in on Instagram’s official page without creating your own Meta developer app. It is run by the author of this plugin.

  • When: only when you click “Connect with Instagram”. The plugin first checks that the service is available (a request to foliocast.fr/connect/health with no data from your site; a positive answer is remembered for one day, a failure for one hour, and in the meantime no new check is made), then opens the service’s login page. Opening the setup assistant sends nothing.
  • What is sent: the address of your site, a one-time security code and the language of the plugin’s interface, so that the service’s pages can use it. Instagram sends your access token to the service, which hands it straight to your site; it is kept encrypted for 5 minutes at most for that handover, then deleted.
  • Tester invitation: while Meta reviews the Foliocast app, only accounts invited as Instagram testers can connect. If you fill in the “Request my invitation” form shown after clicking “Connect with Instagram”, the plugin sends the email address and Instagram account name you typed, your site’s host name and the interface language to foliocast.fr/connect/invite, so that the team can invite your account and email you the steps. Nothing is sent if you do not fill in the form.
  • Terms: https://foliocast.fr/cgu.html
  • Privacy policy: https://foliocast.fr/privacy.html (in French: https://foliocast.fr/confidentialite.html)

You can also connect Instagram without this service, by pasting an access token from your own Meta app in Settings.

Foliocast Pulse (foliocast.fr, optional)

Used only if you choose “At the exact time” in the last step of the setup assistant, or click “Turn on on-time publishing” in Settings → Automatic publishing. The service calls your site every minute so that scheduled posts go out on time without a cron job at your host. It is run by the author of this plugin. With a paid plan add-on, it turns on by itself when your site (HTTPS only) has no cron job, unless you chose “On the next visit to your site”; you can turn it off in Settings.

  • When: when you turn it on or off, when you create a new scheduled-task key while it is on (the service receives the new key), when you open Settings while it is on (status check, remembered for 10 minutes), and when you deactivate or delete the plugin while it is on (your site is removed from the service). Then the service calls your site’s check address every minute.
  • What is sent: your site’s address, its check address (/wp-json/foliocast/v1/tick), the scheduled-task key, which only allows starting that check, and the plugin version. Turning it off, deactivating or deleting the plugin deletes this data from the service.
  • Terms: https://foliocast.fr/cgu.html — Privacy policy: https://foliocast.fr/privacy.html

Your portfolio on another site (optional)

Only if you choose to import a portfolio that is not on this WordPress site.

  • When: when you paste its address in the setup assistant, then once a day to look for new projects.
  • What is requested: the public pages, sitemap, feed and images of the address you entered, from your own site, with the user agent FoliocastReader. Nothing about you or your visitors is sent. A site can refuse it with User-agent: FoliocastReader and Disallow: / in its robots.txt.
  • More: https://foliocast.fr/robot.html

Cloudinary (optional)

Only if you enter your own Cloudinary credentials in Settings. Cloudinary then hosts the images and videos at publishing time, and converts videos to the 9:16 Reel format when your server cannot.

  • When: when you save your Cloudinary credentials (a check of the credentials), when a post is published (upload, then deletion of the copy once Instagram has it), and when you import a video while Cloudinary is connected.
  • What is sent: the image or video file, signed with your Cloudinary API key.
  • Cloudinary Terms of Use: https://cloudinary.com/tos
  • Cloudinary Privacy Policy: https://cloudinary.com/privacy

Credits

  • Demo images (assets/demo): original artworks made for the Foliocast demo, GPL-2.0-or-later.
  • Fonts, served by the plugin itself (nothing is loaded from another site), SIL Open Font License 1.1: Instrument Sans (fonts/OFL.txt), Anton, Archivo and IBM Plex Mono (assets/app/fonts/OFL.txt and assets/app/fonts/archivo-OFL.txt).

Source code

All JavaScript and CSS is shipped unminified. assets/app/app.js is the files of assets/app/src/ put end to end (cat i18n.js app.js reels.js learn.js results.js system.js ui.js onboard.js help.js growth.js > ../app.js, see assets/app/src/README.md); every other script and style sheet is its own source. No third-party library is bundled.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Open Foliocast in the admin menu: the setup assistant reads your projects, lets you choose them, prepares the posts, then connects Instagram.
  3. In Settings → Automatic publishing, click Turn on on-time publishing (or add the cron command shown there).
sections.faq:
Does my Instagram account need to be professional?

Yes, Instagram only lets applications publish for Creator or Business accounts. Switching is free in the Instagram app.

Where are my data stored?

On your own site; the Instagram access token is stored encrypted. Removing the plugin keeps your data unless you tick “Delete all data when uninstalling” in Settings → Show all → Maintenance. To keep the encryption key out of the database, define FOLIOCAST_ENCRYPTION_KEY (32 characters or more) in wp-config.php, then connect Instagram again.

My posts are published late.

Turn on on-time publishing in Settings → Automatic publishing, or add the cron command shown there (every minute).

My portfolio is not on WordPress.

Install Foliocast on any WordPress site, then paste your portfolio’s address in the setup assistant. Your portfolio itself is not changed.

Does Foliocast add anything to my captions?

Only what you set up. The optional #foliocast mention stays off unless you choose it, and can be turned off at any time.

Is Foliocast affiliated with Instagram or Meta?

No. It publishes through the official Instagram API, only to the account you connect.
sections.changelog:
3.2.3

  • Reliability: “Approve all” started at the same time from two tabs or by two people no longer loses or duplicates a post, nor deletes one of its visuals; a post affected before this version is picked up by the next “Approve all”.
  • Reliability: when Instagram does not let the plugin read your account’s media list right after posting, a post that is live is no longer marked as failed.
  • Getting started: a site whose projects have no images yet no longer shows “projects found”; the assistant says what to do.
  • Getting started: no more opening date for Foliocast online in the Read step.
  • Help and Settings: paid plans are described as on the Pricing page, without a date; they add the Foliocast Pro plugin, installed next to this one. “See the plans” links open the plans on the Pricing page.
  • One word for the planner throughout the app (extending, restoring a backup, setup assistant, posts outside the planner).
  • “Too late to undo” now names the backups card exactly (English, Spanish, Portuguese).
  • Connecting Instagram: the plugin sends the interface language to Foliocast Connect, so that its pages can use it (stated in External services).
  • “Delete all data when uninstalling” also removes the record of missed storage locks (foliocast_lock_miss).
  • Plugin Check: no more errors (internal error message escaped, no HTML in translatable strings).
  • Translation catalogue trimmed: about 270 unused strings removed.

3.2.2

  • Screenshots of the current interface on the plugin page. Nothing else changes.

3.2.1

  • The line under the logo now reads “Your work, posted.” instead of an old default line (a line you wrote yourself is kept).
  • Shorter plugin description, and new banner and icon.

3.2.0

  • New interface: a sidebar with four spaces (This week, New post, Planner, Results), Settings and Help at the bottom, a scrolling row of spaces on phones.
  • Light theme by default and a reworked dark theme; new default accent color (a color you chose is kept).
  • This week says in one sentence what waits for you: posts to approve as cards (approve, edit day, time and caption, later), “Approve all until …” with Undo, next post and the seven days.
  • Planner opens on the month (a list on phones), with a “Move” button on each post, and a legend of statuses. Statuses read as a shape and a word, never color alone.
  • Results titles come from your figures. Settings use segmented choices and switches.
  • The interface fonts are served by the plugin (Archivo variable font added).
  • The paid plans card is shorter and dated offers are gone.

2.21.2

  • Safer publishing: when you redo a post that may already be on Instagram (“to check”), with its hashtags in the first comment, or paste its caption into another scheduled post, Foliocast first asks “Already online?” and checks your account before sending.
  • The “On hold” email no longer announces a new attempt that will not happen.
  • Keyboard: the Tab key stays inside dialogs and reaches every focusable element, never one taken out of the tab order.
  • The app reads its routes only from the address, never from the content of a request.
  • Wording of the paid plans updated (Reels of 15 to 30 seconds).

Older versions: see changelog.txt in the plugin folder.

screenshots.caption: This week: the posts waiting for your approval, with their visual, caption and time. Approve one, or all at once.
The calendar: month view with the status of every post. Drag a post onto another day to change its date.
The post editor: visuals, caption and an Instagram preview of what your followers will see.
New post: drop an image to crop it for Instagram, or use a file that is already ready.
Results: reach and interactions of your posts, and which projects your audience prefers.
